title: Jevil
description: What Jevil rules, labels and merges, when, and what Jev costs. docs/jevil.md

panels.title: Last poll
panels.description: Time since the last poll cycle completed. Jevil polls every 5 minutes; over 15 minutes means it is stuck or failing (see Errors and the log below).

panels.title: Merging
panels.description: HALTED while a pull request carries jevil:merged-unhealthy: a merged deploy failed its check, a revert pull request is waiting for you, and Jevil merges nothing until the label is removed.

panels.title: Mode
panels.description: shadow: Jevil labels and comments, you merge. merge: Jevil merges what passes. Set per scope in apps/jevil/policy.json.

panels.title: Open pull requests by ruling
panels.description: Open Chore Bore pull requests by Jevil's current ruling: pass, review (a human decides) or wait (a status, release age or reconcile is pending).

panels.title: Errors (24h)
panels.description: Failed poll cycles plus pull requests Jevil could not rule on, last 24 hours. The log below names the cause.

panels.title: Merge success (30d)
panels.description: Share of Jevil's merges in the last 30 days that were not rolled back: 1 - rollbacks / merges. Merges of revert pull requests count as neither.

panels.title: Rollbacks (30d)
panels.description: Revert pull requests Jevil opened in the last 30 days: after an unhealthy deploy, or on /jevil revert. Reverts done by hand outside Jevil, and Talos/Kubernetes upgrades (never reverted), are not counted.

panels.title: Merges (30d)
panels.description: Pull requests Jevil merged in the last 30 days, on /jevil merge or its own Renovate ruling, not counting revert pull requests.

panels.title: Deploy checks passed (30d)
panels.description: Post-merge deploy checks in the last 30 days that ended ok rather than unhealthy (failed reconcile, timeout, or a container restart while soaking). Includes upgrades, which turn unhealthy without a revert.

panels.title: Merges and rollbacks per day
panels.description: Merges Jevil made each day (revert pull requests excluded) and the revert pull requests it opened, by trigger: unhealthy (deploy check failed) or command (/jevil revert).

panels.title: Merge queue
panels.description: Pull requests queued with /jevil merge, in merge order, and what each is waiting for. Rebuilt every poll.

targets.expr: max by (position, pr, title, by, status, reason, allow) (jevil_queue_entry) * 1000

panels.title: Watching after merge
panels.description: Merged pull requests whose deploy Jevil is still checking (Flux, HelmRelease, Terrakube, tuppr upgrades). Nothing else merges until these settle.

defaults.noValue: Nothing merged is waiting to go live

panels.title: Cluster health gate
panels.description: What holds every merge right now: nodes NotReady, unhealthy attached Longhorn volumes, tuppr upgrades not Completed, failing Kustomizations. A pull request touching the failing thing itself is exempt.

panels.title: Open pull requests
panels.description: Every open pull request: author, Jevil's ruling (Chore Bore pull requests only), the jevil/checks summary and queue state.

targets.expr: max by (pr, title, author, ruling, checks, state) (jevil_open_pull_request)

panels.title: Merges and deploys
panels.description: Every merge (which PR, merge commit, why, what deploys it), when it went live or turned unhealthy, and queue drops.

targets.expr: {namespace="jevil"} | json | msg=~"merged|deploy ok|deploy unhealthy|merge failed|dequeued" | line_format `{{ if eq .msg "merged" }}🃏 #{{.pr}} merged as {{ trunc 7 .sha }}: {{.title}} — {{.why}}. Deploys: {{.targets}}{{ else if eq .msg "deploy ok" }}✅ #{{.pr}} live: {{.detail}}{{ else if eq .msg "deploy unhealthy" }}❌ #{{.pr}} unhealthy: {{.detail}}{{ else if eq .msg "dequeued" }}↩️ #{{.pr}} dequeued: {{.reason}}{{ else }}⚠️ #{{.pr}} merge failed: {{.err}}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Replies
panels.description: Every comment Jevil posted or edited: the pull request, the kind (ruling, report, reply, queued, waiting, dequeued, merged, live, unhealthy, progress) and its first line.

panels.title: Check runs
panels.description: Each time the pre-merge checks ran on a pull request head: findings, blocking findings and the targets it deploys.

targets.expr: {namespace="jevil"} | json | msg="report" | line_format `#{{.pr}}: {{.findings}} findings, {{.blocking}} blocking{{ if .error }}, could not run: {{.error}}{{ end }} — deploys {{.targets}}`

panels.title: Poll runs
panels.description: One line per poll: how long it took and what it saw.

targets.expr: {namespace="jevil"} | json | msg=~"cycle|cycle failed" | line_format `{{ if .err }}❌ {{.err}}{{ else }}{{.duration_s}}s · {{.open}} open · {{.ruled}} ruled · {{.queued}} queued · {{.watching}} watching · {{.health_problems}} health problems{{ if .merged }} · merged #{{.merged}}{{ end }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Comments per hour
panels.description: Comments Jevil posted (solid) and edited in place, by kind.

panels.title: Queued
panels.description: Pull requests waiting for Jevil after /jevil merge: on a pending check, or behind a deploy that is being checked.

panels.title: Merged and dequeued
panels.description: merged: by /jevil merge (command) or on Jevil's own ruling (renovate). dequeued: a readiness check failed; the pull request comment says which.

panels.title: Rulings written
panels.description: Each bar is an hour. A ruling is written when it changes: a new pull request, a new head commit, a status turning green, or a policy change.

panels.title: Merges and deploy checks
panels.description: Every merge Jevil made (command or renovate) and the outcome of the deploy check after it (ok or unhealthy).

panels.title: GitHub rate limit left
panels.description: Requests left in the current window: core is 5000/hour for the App installation, search 30/minute.

panels.title: Cost (24h)
panels.description: Jev cost as reported by OpenRouter per response (usage.cost). Counters reset on pod restart, so short gaps undercount slightly.

panels.title: Projected per month
panels.description: Last 7 days' spend rate times 30 days.

panels.title: Cached answers (7d)
panels.description: Share of rulings that reused the Jev answers stored in the pull request comment instead of paying for a new call.

panels.title: Jev requests
panels.description: ok, retried (429/529/5xx, backed off) and error. Errors leave the pull request unruled until the next poll.

panels.title: Passed but you closed it
panels.description: Pull requests Jevil passed that were closed without merging. Must stay 0 before a scope moves to merge mode (docs/jevil.md).

panels.title: Agreement
panels.description: Closed pull requests where you did what Jevil said: merged a pass, or closed a review. The bar for merge mode is 95%.

panels.title: Closed pull requests by ruling and outcome
Jev answers on open pull requests

defaults.noValue: No open pull request has Jev answers (none with release notes to judge)

panels.description: P(yes) per question. breaking, migration, data_risk and addressed_to_bot send a pull request to review at 0.3 or more; drop_in below 0.7. Thresholds live in apps/jevil/policy.json.

panels.title: Rulings, Jev calls, merges and deploy checks

targets.expr: {namespace="jevil"} | json | msg=~"ruled|command|dequeued|queue waiting|labels synced|jev answered|merged|merge skipped|merge failed|deploy ok|deploy unhealthy|command|cycle failed|ruling failed|starting|stopping"
